'''Aldogh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] who served as a supervisor of the Ortolan colony on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Aldogh was supervising an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Ortolan colony|colony]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] around the [[Crescent Canyon tech depot]]. When he discovered that [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] had attacked the facility, he was able to send a distress call to [[Aurek Base]], which sent a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to assist. An Imperial officer named [[Korl Torin]] tortured Aldogh, who revealed to him about the gas pipes under the facility that could be used to blow up Aurek Base from below. When Torin left, Aldogh barricaded himself until the help could arrive.<ref name="TOR" />
